gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-padyakke-expan: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its round, wide-mouthed letters out like knots on a slack rope, serious and bookish in tone. Red Hat Display sits above it, bold and marker-drawn.
gen-orbitron-fs-bespoke-slab: Orbitron stretches its letters far apart, precise and nearly bare. Bespoke Slab, the text serif, stands tall beneath it, so a slightly generous body size lets its lowercase settle in.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-inika: Tight, strong, no wasted space. Oswald packs its rows hard, while Inika, a text serif with an open s, lets a long page unspool in an old-fashioned, unhurried way.
gen-almendra-display-gf-athiti: Almendra Display brings ornate, storybook letters with a pronounced x-height and nothing pinched shut. Athiti follows in a thin, single-width line, and a long page of it would feel modern and easygoing.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-kiwi-maru: Red Hat Display draws everything with a marker's constant line, daylight showing inside each curve. And Kiwi Maru, a text serif, takes over for the sustained reading, with generous spacing and terminals that stop well short of the stem.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kay-pho-du: Confident from the first word, Oswald crowds its lines into tight rows. Kay Pho Du, a classic serif, traces its letters in one pen-like track, so a long page feels traditional and open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height rising high. Atkinson Hyperlegible, the sans-serif, adds wide-set terminals on the s, giving the pair a bookish headline over a very approachable text.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-stint-ultra-ex: Red Hat Display draws a bold, marker-like line with visible daylight inside every curve, set over a serif that floats apart. Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character stand alone.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-amulya: Amulya, a sans-serif with generous gaps in its curves, feels modern and quietly open, which suits the neon-tube strokes of the heading. Red Hat Display carries the weight above.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-labrada: Tough, narrow and sure of itself, Oswald packs each line tight above Labrada, a classic serif with wide openings in its small letters. Reading on feels dignified, like an old book.
